name: remote-tailnet-guard
description: Persistent DSH plugin face of remote-tailnet-guard (display name dsh-crossnet-link): the plugins-page settings card that edits this link guard's own check parameters (settings.plugin.item, keyed by the remote-tailnet-guard settings namespace), plus a read-only HTTP route that runs the repository's read-only collector (src/collect.ps1 -CheckOnly -AsJson) with those stored parameters. The host half writes no settings document itself - the card saves through the platform settings service into the user's own settings - opens no listener, reads no credential material and changes no system setting. The loader row ships disabled: see plugin/cordis.patch.yml.
